alt: The agent loop drawn as a circular track: perceive, think, act, and remember in sequence, returning to perceive until the task is complete or a stop condition ends the run. A task enters at perceive, the run exits from remember, and the context window at the centre fills with each pass until its newest tokens spill past the edge.
caption: Each phase has its own failure modes: infinite loops start in act, context exhaustion and lost tool results start in remember.
